notes: The clause writes both a 1cs verb and an explicit אֲנִי against one English 'I'; the present pronoun takes the word and the verb keeps 'said'. The competing reading gives 'I said' whole to the verb under rule 17 and marks the pronoun unrepresented; it is named in the unit note.
Two 'there's are written: the presentative frame at t015-t016 joins the predicate noun עֵת with its indefinite article, and the adverb שָׁם takes the second at t019 (rules 20, 15 and 25).
s024's article is unrepresented because the כֹּל standing on the noun is what the single written 'every' renders (rule 41's limit).
